messages:
amanda: Quick sync — we need to lock a decision on what stays in the MVP vs what slides to v1. Dennis pushed for customer security audit before launch; that could add 3 weeks. Thoughts?

raj: If the audit is mandatory for the pilot customer, we can do a thin audit scaffold (logs + KMS stub) in MVP and a full audit in v1. Saves 2+ weeks.

linh: Agree with raj. Also we should protect core latency SLOs — adding the full audit path could change codepaths and risk regressions.

amanda: Proposal: MVP includes audit stub + explicit rollout blocker: no GA without full audit complete. Keep pilot allowed with signed waiver. Is that acceptable to sales/legal? @dennis? :thinking_face:

dennis: Pilot customer said they need "audit-able logs" not necessarily SOC-level reports for pilot. Waiver ok for pilot, but GA buyers will expect the full audit. We can accept the staged approach.

eva: From design POV, we should hide audit UI until v1 to avoid confusion. In MVP show a single checkbox "generate logs for audit" and a short tooltip.

raj: On scope cuts: if we move the embedding-reindex feature to v1, we keep MVP CPU/GPU footprint predictable. Reindex could complicate batch windows.

amanda: Good call. So far cuts to move to v1: embedding-reindex, full audit UI, advanced batching config. Keep: model pinning, basic routing, telemetry, canary flows.

linh: We need a measurable launch criteria list. Suggest: 1) 95th perc latency <= 250ms on p99 for small traffic profile, 2) successful canary with no regressions for 72h, 3) pilot customer signed waiver if full audit not done.

amanda: I like that. Add a quality gate: no regression in our promptset evals beyond 1.5% BLEU drop (or equivalent).

raj: Ops ask: if we hit unexpected perf degradation, fallback plan should auto-route to hosted-legacy model. Is that in config? deploy-bot: can set fallback policy to "hosted-legacy" for rollout clusters.

amanda: Action list: (1) raj to prototype audit stub + fallback routing (ETA 4d), (2) eva to create MVP audit UX copy (2d), (3) linh to add the three launch criteria to tracking board (today), (4) dennis to confirm pilot waiver language with customer legal (EOD).

dennis: Confirmed — I'll ask legal and report back.

amanda: If anyone sees a hard blocker to these cuts, flag it now. Otherwise I'll mark this as the official scope triage and update the milestone board. :white_check_mark:

linh: No blockers from data side.

raj: No blockers from infra. Will start work.

amanda: Great — thanks team. Will update milestone tracker and ping stakeholders for alignment later today.
